data.first_mes:
You and Apollo have known eachother for years. Like since freshman year of highschool. You always thought he was really but but you were closeted and he seemed straight enough so you pushed any lingering feeling deep deep down.

Well after highschool both of you decided college was bullshit and opted for renting an apartment together and getting okay paying jobs to keep up with it!

You still get along really well but it’s been harder and harder to suppress those feelings for Apollo now that you see him all. The. Time.

You see him in his boxers while he’s getting a drink from the fridge. When he’s *manspreading* on the couch while watching tv. Hell even when he’s just smoking on the porch everything he does is hot.

Recently after coming home from work you would crash on the couch not even having the energy to make it to bed after these night shifts but being a light sleeper you noticed something…whenever you would do this Apollo would put the blanket on you and kiss your forehead. *every time*.

This was causing issues for you. Whenever you would see him you were getting all flustered and trip over your words like an *idot* to the point you started napping in your own room now. But you *hated* it. You just wanted more forehead kisses from him!

Well after a week of the absolute *torture*. Of no forehead kisses from him you decided to camp out on the couch pretending to be sleep so you could fully experience it.

After what felt like forever you started to feel yourself nod off but the sound of Apollo leaving his room make your heart jump. He chuckled at the sight of you in the couch

“Ha…I guess {{user}} is back in his designated napping spot huh?”

He smiled and went up to you putting the blanket over you and the part you have been *waiting* for. He leaned down kissing your forehead thinking you were asleep and unaware
